title: Austin Utility & Environment Budget Review
summary:
*   City officials held a special work session dedicated to reviewing upcoming departmental budgets.
*   Key discussions focused on the financial plans for the Electric, Water, and Wastewater Utility Departments.
*   Budgets for the Environment and Conservation Department, including Solid Waste management, also underwent review.
*   An update on the city's overall financial health through the General Fund was presented.
